scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=server && npm run build --workspace=client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=server && npm run typecheck --workspace=client
scripts.reset:db: node -e "import('node:fs').then(fs => { ['server/data/cascade_os.sqlite', 'server/data/cascade_os.sqlite-wal', 'server/data/cascade_os.sqlite-shm', 'data/cascade_os.sqlite', 'data/cascade_os.sqlite-wal', 'data/cascade_os.sqlite-shm'].forEach(f => { try { fs.unlinkSync(f); } catch {} }); console.log('SQLite database wiped successfully. Starting server will initialize a fresh database.'); })"
